description:
Find images on the web by text query OR by a reference image — returns ranked results (title, source page, dimensions, thumbnail, description, summary). Pass exactly one of: a text `query`, an `image_url` (a picture already on the web), or `image_data` (base64, for a picture you hold). Never more than one. Use this when the user wants pictures, photos, diagrams, screenshots, or visual references — not for general text web search.

keywords: find images, image search, photos, pictures, screenshots, visual reference, diagram, icon, illustration, reference image

count.description: Number of results to return (1-10). Default 5.

image_data.description: Base64-encoded image to search by visual similarity, for an image you hold rather than one already on the web. At most 5MB encoded; JPEG, PNG, WEBP, BMP, TIFF, ICO, DIB, ICNS or SGI. A `data:` URI is accepted — its payload is used. Exactly one of `query`, `image_url` or `image_data` — never more than one.

image_url.description: Public image URL to search by visual similarity. Exactly one of `query`, `image_url` or `image_data` — never more than one.

include_domains.description: Only return results from these domains (e.g. 'unsplash.com').

query.description: Text query describing the images to find. Exactly one of `query`, `image_url` or `image_data` — never more than one.

timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds (1-60). Defaults to 30s if unset.

name: image_search
title: Image Search
